title: Scratchpad Reasoning as a Misalignment Early Warning System

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If scratchpad features reliably predict misaligned outputs, this offers an interpretable, model-agnostic monitoring approach. Clear chain from finding to a deployable monitoring technique.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Eliciting CoT from open models under varied prompting conditions is feasible. Classifying scratchpad content along defined axes is straightforward text classification. Medium compute suffices.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Could be scoped to one model with monitored/unmonitored framing, coding a few scratchpad features, and measuring predictive accuracy. Multiple prompt conditions add breadth but can be limited.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
